resolution: class metrics are STATE-level, applied to the regions within that state. Sub-state resolution requires per-region station selection and is not yet done.

sources.name: NOAA COOP/GHCN/airport stations via RCC-ACIS
sources.gives: daily max/min temperature and precipitation per station

sources.name: USDA SSURGO Soil Data Access
sources.gives: available water capacity, drainage class, slope

PINTO.quality_driver: seed-coat brightness and uniform mottling; dullness and stain cost more than yield

GREAT NORTHERN.quality_driver: clean white seed coat and uniform size; any staining is visible and penalised

NAVY.quality_driver: whiteness above all; small uniform seed. Staining is fatal to grade

BLACK.quality_driver: deep colour retention and shine; dark coat conceals blemish, so pick matters less

LIGHT RED KIDNEY.quality_driver: large seed size is the grade; colour brightness second

DARK RED KIDNEY.quality_driver: large seed size and deep colour

PINK.quality_driver: even colour; sized similar to pinto

SMALL RED.quality_driver: colour depth and small uniform size

CRANBERRY.quality_driver: bold seed and sharp mottle contrast — appearance is the whole market

BLACKEYE.quality_driver: clean white ground colour with sharp eye

GARBANZO (KABULI).quality_driver: seed SIZE is the grade — 9mm+ garbanzo commands the premium — plus pale even colour

GARBANZO (DESI).quality_driver: mostly split and milled, so appearance matters far less than kabuli

LENTIL LARGE GREEN.quality_driver: size and green colour retention; sold whole, so appearance is the price

LENTIL RED.quality_driver: milling yield, not appearance — the seed coat is removed

PEA YELLOW.quality_driver: soundness and low split; colour is stable

PEA GREEN.quality_driver: GREEN COLOUR RETENTION is the grade and the premium
